summary.purpose: Metadata/image provider layer: the ProviderManager orchestration surface + XbmcMetadata (Kodi) .nfo parse/write + LocalMetadata local-image discovery + a thin ffprobe-backed MediaInfo provider that borrows a MediaEncoder trait object.
summary.portability: Mixed. The XbmcMetadata NFO parsers are highly portable, pure XML->struct logic with a rich xUnit parity oracle (fixture .nfo files). The Manager/ProviderManager.cs (1322 LOC) is mostly runtime machinery (DI graph, PriorityQueue refresh loop, HttpClientFactory, memory cache, AsyncKeyedLock image dedupe, strategy-interface registration) that is out of scope; only the ProviderManager TRAIT surface (already defined in hermit-traits) is implemented, as a thin orchestrator. LocalMetadata local images are pure filename-convention logic.
summary.scope_note: SCOPED DOWN per PortJob. Port order: ProviderManager trait impl (thin) + minimal refresh orchestration + XbmcMetadata NFO parse/write + LocalMetadata local images + ffprobe MediaInfo provider (&dyn MediaEncoder). DEFER all remote-API plugins (Tmdb/MusicBrainz/Omdb/AudioDb/ListenBrainz/StudioImages) as feature-gated stubs.

key_finding_missing_model_types.note: MetadataResult<T>, PersonInfo, ItemInfo, LocalImageInfo, MetadataResult.UserData live in MediaBrowser.Controller.Providers, NOT MediaBrowser.Model, so they are NOT in hermit-model. They must be created LOCALLY in hermit-providers as the parse/refresh container types. hermit-model already provides: ImageType, MetadataProvider, Video3DFormat, RemoteImageInfo, ExternalIdInfo, RemoteSearchResult, BaseItemDto, BaseItemPerson, MetadataOptions/MetadataPluginSummary. hermit-traits provides: ProviderManager trait, MediaEncoder trait (media_encoding.rs), ItemImageInfo, error::ServiceError.
key_finding_missing_model_types.item_entities: hermit-model has NO Movie/Series/Episode/Season/MusicAlbum/MusicArtist domain entity structs (Controller-layer types). The NFO parser needs a mutable item target: port as a local `NfoItem`/generic MetadataResult<Item> with the union of fields the parsers write (title, original_title, tagline, provider_ids, genres, studios, premiere/end date, aspect_ratio, video3d, width/height, runtime_ticks, ratings, people, remote_images, remote_trailers, collection_name, date_created, plus TV/episode/album/artist specifics).

hermit_traits.ProviderManager: trait to implement (target of this port)
hermit_traits.MediaEncoder (media_encoding.rs): borrowed as &dyn by the ffprobe MediaInfo provider; do NOT depend on hermit-mediaencoding

PersonInfo { name, role, type (PersonKind), sort_order, image_url, provider_ids }
ItemInfo (path/kind wrapper used by GetXmlFile save-path resolution)

ordered_units.name: unit-2-xbmc-nfo-parsers
ordered_units.title: XbmcMetadata NFO parsers (PARITY ORACLE)
contents: BaseNfoParser<T> (1029 LOC) — quick-xml pull parser; SupportsUrlAfterClosingXmlTag handling; FetchDataFromXmlNode field switch; uniqueid/id normalization via GetExternalIdInfos + additional mappings; CommunityRating 0-10 range + comma-decimal handling; fanart/thumb image extraction; people (actor/director/writer/lyricist with role/sortorder/thumb); remote trailers; XML entity unescaping
MovieNfoParser (SupportsUrlAfterClosingXmlTag=true, set/collection, tmdbcol)
EpisodeNfoParser (multi-episode, thumb-without-aspect)
SeriesNfoParser, SeasonNfoParser, SeriesNfoSeasonParser
NfoConfiguration (XbmcMetadataOptions: UserId, ReleaseDateFormat, SaveImagePathsInNfo, EnablePathSubstitution, EnableExtraThumbsDuplication) from Configuration/*
GetExternalIdInfos supplied via injected ProviderManager trait object (as in C# tests)
ordered_units.notes: HIGH value. Transliterate the XbmcMetadata.Tests parser suite against Test Data/*.nfo fixtures (copy fixtures into crate tests/data). This is the crate's primary parity oracle.

ordered_units.name: unit-3-xbmc-nfo-savers-and-providers
ordered_units.title: XbmcMetadata NFO savers + provider wiring
contents: BaseNfoSaver (1063 LOC) — quick-xml writer; AddCommonNodes; round-trips fields written by parsers; GetMovieSavePaths/save-path resolution
Movie/Episode/Series/Season/Album/Artist NfoSaver
NfoUserDataSaver (87 LOC)
BaseNfoProvider / BaseVideoNfoProvider / per-type NfoProvider wiring (GetXmlFile -> parser.Fetch)
ordered_units.notes: Savers verified indirectly by parse->save->parse round-trip; direct saver xUnit coverage is thin, so lean on round-trip assertions.

ordered_units.name: unit-4-localmetadata-images
ordered_units.title: LocalMetadata local-image discovery
contents: LocalImageProvider (495 LOC) — filename-convention image discovery (_commonImageFileNames/_musicImageFileNames/_personImageFileNames/_seriesImageFileNames/_videoImageFileNames, backdrop/fanart/logo/banner/thumb/disc detection, index parsing)
EpisodeLocalImageProvider, CollectionFolderLocalImageProvider, InternalMetadataFolderImageProvider
BaseXmlProvider + XmlProviderUtils + BoxSet/Playlist XML parsers/savers (LocalMetadata Parsers/Savers) — port if cheap, else defer non-image XML
DirectoryService abstraction (inject file listing; keep filesystem behind a small trait/closure for testability)
ordered_units.notes: Independent of NFO units except shared container types; can be built in parallel with unit-2/3. No dedicated xUnit suite here — cover with focused Rust unit tests over a temp dir.

ordered_units.name: unit-5-provider-manager-and-mediainfo
ordered_units.title: ProviderManager trait impl + ffprobe MediaInfo provider + deferred plugin stubs
contents: ProviderManager trait impl (thin orchestrator over units 2-4): save_image/save_image_from_url, get_external_urls/get_external_id_infos, get_all_metadata_plugins, get_metadata_options, refresh_single_item/refresh_full_item/queue_refresh (in-process, no PriorityQueue/HttpClientFactory machinery)
MediaInfo probe provider (ProbeProvider/FFProbeVideoInfo subset) taking &dyn hermit_traits::MediaEncoder; map ffprobe MediaInfo -> item streams/runtime; NO dependency on hermit-mediaencoding
ImageSaver subset behind the save_image trait methods
DEFERRED remote-API plugins as feature-gated stubs: tmdb/musicbrainz/omdb features (default off) + AudioDb/ListenBrainz/StudioImages skipped-and-logged
ordered_units.notes: Top of the stack; wires the trait. Manager/ProviderManager.cs runtime machinery (DI, refresh loop, memory cache, AsyncKeyedLock) is intentionally reduced to the object-safe trait surface.
